title: knoxia teres
intro: Knoxia teres, commonly known as Indian snakeroot, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to the tropical regions of India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Knoxia teres include its use in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and snake bites. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antivenom properties, which are attributed to its ability to neutralize snake venom. The bioactive constituents of Knoxia teres include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
